goal: Prepare a bounded temporal evaluation core and exact root/local squared-error decomposition before loading any real model or public motion array.
single_main_variable: Evaluation contract only, no new pose predictor, no policy update
contracts: strict equal lengths and finite 3D positions; declared root index/time units/coordinate frame; monotonic timestamps
fixed GT-axis coverage plus common-method coverage; no silent deletion of unmatched frames
50ms maximum nearest-match error fixed for public-data comparison based on author flag, not a validated device latency threshold
world joint MSE = root MSE + root-relative joint MSE + root/local cross term; MPJPE reported separately
GT-root replacement is an undeployable counterfactual, not a guaranteed upper/lower bound on whole-body error
root-only baseline claim requires checking local joint equality first
controls: pure root translation with unchanged local pose
opposite-signed cross term where naive additive attribution fails
different method availability preserves per-method and common denominators
mismatched length/NaN/unknown frame or root rejected
actual_public_replay: NOT_REGISTERED: require source download, SHA, data rights, shape/split check; no training on published evaluation bundle
compute_boundary: Small synthetic scalar controls on Mac only; tensor/model/IK/simulation/training on exclusive healthy ZHY only, do not alter main-thread protection.
after_controls: One bounded check of the selected public bundle access/content/data terms. If no admissible data remains, save a concrete recovery point and stop repeating source queries.
novelty: Tooling and geometry are established methods; intended control-sensitive contribution remains an untested hypothesis.
preregistration_clarification: Before any HB06 execution: an analytically negative root/local cross term means replacing root with ground truth is not a guaranteed error bound; code and controls record the cross term and counterfactual without an upper-bound claim.
